nativeValidation.setup: Use PowerShell in a short disposable checkout on a local NTFS drive at the stated SHA. Run the non-elevated checks on delino-win-1, then repeat them on a disposable host when LongPathsEnabled is already disabled before the test process starts. These checks require no symlinks, tar extraction, protected ACLs, service control or Hyper-V.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'ebae371717ce542f8bd87a80ad9dc43a3336b285') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

go test '-v' '-count=1' '-timeout=2m' '-run' '^(TestOpenServiceLog.*|TestResetDeletesStateWhileServiceLogIsOpen|TestStartupDiagnosticForInvalidConfiguration)$' './cmds/ownsand-agent' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-tests.log'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows service log tests failed' }
expectedResults: Go exits zero. The conversion cases pass for short drive and UNC paths, a short Unicode path, long local and UNC paths, a relative path and already prefixed paths.
The test creates a log at an ordinary absolute path above MAX_PATH, appends three JSON records in order, reads with a writer open, and deletes the log while that writer is still open.

The same writable log accepts its already-prefixed path as a second writer. A directory at agent.log yields the existing Windows open diagnostic, and the startup fallback fixture receives a redacted diagnostic.
The ordinary-path reset fixture deletes the log and identity while the log handle remains open.

If LongPathsEnabled is 1, the test confirms the conversion and Windows file behavior on that host. Baseline reproduction and disabled-policy acceptance require a disposable Windows environment where the displayed value is 0 or absent.

requiresElevation.reason: Service registration, service control and registration of the Application Event Log source need administrator access. The non-elevated Windows account cannot run this probe.
requiresElevation.setup: Use an elevated PowerShell 7 session on a disposable Windows host with LongPathsEnabled already disabled and no installed ownsand-agent service. LocalSystem needs read and execute access to the checkout and write access to its .t3-tmp directory. After creating the scratch directory, copy the probe from files.copyFrom to files.copyTo using ordinary file transfer.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'ebae371717ce542f8bd87a80ad9dc43a3336b285') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

$probe = Join-Path $work 'scm-long-log.ps1'; if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $probe).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne '1aa93868d629dd1fd234333223287dcf2ca5a21bfc0809f73a995fe36cf42d51') { throw 'Unexpected probe checksum' }
pwsh -NoProfile -File $probe 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-scm.log'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'SCM probe failed' }
expectedResults: The service starts two times with a disposable invalid log-level fixture, exits with SCM code 1066 and service exit 2 each time, and appends two redacted JSON records at the long state path.
With a directory in place of agent.log, the service reports the same exit status and writes a redacted Event ID 1 to the Application Event Log. The script removes the service and scratch state.
limitations: The PowerShell probe was prepared on Linux and awaits native execution.
Changing system long-path policy is outside scope.
